verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms https://supabase.com/openapi.json returns HTTP 200 with an "openapi" key. Supabase's llms.txt explicitly lists it as the OpenAPI 3.0 description of the Management API, covering organizations, projects, branches, and configuration. Database introspection also yields generated type definitions. Missing for 10: evidence of a downloadable OpenAPI spec for the per-project auto-generated Data/REST API, since the published spec covers only the Management API.
